gloss: to spread; to become widespread; to become popular

definitions.gloss: to spread; to become widespread; to become popular; to come into wide use
definitions.explanation: For something — typically a product, technology, practice, or idea — to become widely used or adopted across a society or group. Implies reaching a broad audience.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{普及|ふきゅう}した。
⟦{電気|でんき}{自動車|じどうしゃ}→電気自動車：15581_denkijidousha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{十分|じゅうぶん}→十分：01614_juubun⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{普及|ふきゅう}して⟦いない→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Electric cars haven't yet become sufficiently widespread.

examples.japanese: ⟦インターネット→インターネット：04723_intaanetto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{世界中|せかいじゅう}→世界中：10171_sekaijuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦アクセス→アクセス：10696_akusesu⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Thanks to the spread of the internet, it became possible to access information from all over the world.

notes:
Commonly used in discussions about technology adoption, social trends, and policy outcomes. Often appears as a noun (⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧) modifying other words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{普及|ふきゅう}{率|りつ}→普及率：27131_fukyuuritsu⟧ — adoption rate, penetration rate
- ⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧ — outreach activities, promotional efforts
- ⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧{啓発|けいはつ} — awareness-raising and education
- ⟦{急速|きゅうそく}→急速：02634_kyuusoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{普及|ふきゅう}する — to spread rapidly
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧ — along with the spread of ~

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広|ひろ}まる→広まる：02404_hiromaru⟧ — to spread; more casual and general
- ⟦{浸透|しんとう}する→浸透する：22181_shintousuru⟧ — to permeate; implies gradual, deep absorption into society
- ⟦{流行|りゅうこう}→流行：03678_ryuukou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to be in fashion, to be trendy; implies temporary popularity
- ⟦{定着|ていちゃく}→定着：07594_teichaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to become established; focuses on being firmly rooted
